meta.title: GATBOX measurement profiles (one source for the logger, report, web and dashboard)
meta.modes_note: Dial modes, keyed the way gatbox-raillog writes them (the '# mode=' header line and /run/gatbox/mode). The UT-D02 link is one-way: the dial sets the mode, software only detects it.
meta.profiles_note: modes = the dial modes the profile accepts ([] = any). Rail ids are ASCII ('+5V', '-5V'); show a real minus sign only on screen. window = [lo, hi] in the mode's base unit, or null. user_window: 'ceiling' (you set hi, lo = 0), 'range' (you set lo and hi) or false. alarm_hi null = derived on rail profiles: max(|lo|, |hi|) x 1.10 of the effective window, compared as a magnitude (so -5V works). A machine's spec for the profile's rail (gatbox-machine-specs.json) overrides the window.

profiles.label: +5V rail
profiles.notes: Overnight log. Clip at the board's power input (JAMMA +5V pin 3/C, GND pin 1/A), not at the PSU.

profiles.label: +5V rail · Neo Geo
profiles.notes: Neo Geo MVS: never over 5.2 V.

profiles.label: −5V rail
profiles.notes: Reads negative with the black lead on GND; a positive reading means the leads are reversed.

profiles.label: Ripple on a rail
profiles.notes: V~ on the DC rail: the AC riding on it. Set the ceiling you'll accept.

profiles.label: Resistance / continuity
profiles.notes: Board unpowered. Capture points to the current machine.

profiles.label: Diode
profiles.notes: Board unpowered. Forward drop in V.

profiles.label: Current
profiles.notes: Red lead in the A or mA/µA jack. MOVE IT BACK TO VΩ before measuring a rail: left in the A jack it shorts the next rail through the meter.

profiles.label: Frequency / duty
profiles.notes: Hz/% on the dial, or the Hz button in a voltage position.

profiles.label: Free
profiles.notes: No checks: shows whatever the dial is on.
